field.label: Enable WAN HA DHCP
field.help: Enable CARP-aware exclusive attachment for the selected DHCP WAN.

field.label: Managed OPNsense Interface
field.help: The logical OPNsense interface managed by this plugin. Version 1 requires IPv4 DHCP.

field.label: Shared WAN MAC
field.help: Ordinary unicast MAC presented to the ISP by the active node. Use Generate Private MAC when no provider-specific MAC is required.

field.label: Failback Delay
field.help: Use zero in this experimental release. Delayed failback is not implemented; native CARP preemption policy applies.
